title: Outlook: Add Custom Flag Descriptions for Clearer Follow-Ups
description: You can add custom text to an email's follow-up flag to describe what you need to do. Use your own words to capture the next step for each flagged message. This gives you a clear reminder of why you flagged the email when you return to it. #newoutlookforwindows
